dedupe_keys.name: urgreecs urban green equity analytics 3 30 300 qgis plugin

description: URGREECS is a QGIS plugin that measures the distribution, accessibility and equity of urban greenery with the 3-30-300 rule: whether buildings see enough nearby tree canopy, whether urban blocks reach 30% green cover and whether residents live within 300 metres of a public green space. Firman Afrianto and Maya Safira published version 1.0.0 in June 2026 in the QGIS plugin repository. It takes canopy height models, population and optional vulnerable group rasters (young children, women, elderly), building footprints, urban blocks, public green space layers and administrative boundaries, and produces building and block indicators, administrative summaries, green equity scores, priority classes, CSV tables and PNG dashboards. Coverage is any city with these inputs; tags point to Indonesian kelurahan-level planning. Format and access: a plugin for QGIS 3 and later with an open source repository. Licence: MIT; free. Caveats: it is new, with one release, and results depend on canopy model quality. It supports green infrastructure and heat adaptation planning. Related catalogue records are the Montreal 3-30-300 indicator and the URBREATH 3-30-300 city rasters.
